name: just-module-creator
description: Author, validate, compile and publish just-dna annotation modules. Ships seven commands, thirteen guides an agent loads by path, and an MCP server whose schema answers are generated from the live just-dna-format models, so they cannot drift from what the compiler accepts — plus literature search across PubMed, Europe PMC, Semantic Scholar, OpenAlex, Crossref and preprints, which the toolchain has nowhere else.
